Done. I've implemented all three functions:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js — constrains n to [min, max] using early returns
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — converts byte counts to B, KB, MB, or GB with one decimal place (except bytes which have no decimal)
3. **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js — lowercases, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, and strips non-alphanumeric characters
